title: The Antipodal Defect of a Convex Polyhedron
summary: Problem C7 from the 2006 IMO Shortlist gives \(A(P)-B(P)=V(P)-1\) for a generic convex polyhedron, where \(A(P)\) counts antipodal vertex pairs and \(B(P)\) counts antipodal edge-midpoint pairs. For an arbitrary convex polyhedron \(P\subset\mathbb{R}^3\), define \(δ(P)=V(P)-1-A(P)+B(P)\). We construct a two-dimensional antipodal square complex \(X(P)\) and prove \(H_0(X(P);\mathbb{Z})\cong\mathbb{Z}\), \(H_1(X(P);\mathbb{Z})\cong\mathbb{Z}/2\), and \(H_2(X(P);\mathbb{Z})\cong\mathbb{Z}^{δ(P)}\).
